title: Checks catch weakened tests and prove fix tests fail without the fix
body:
Source: .krn/runs/research/sector-sweep-1119/report.md "S7 Onboarding".
Outcome: scripts/weak-tests.mjs also flags loosened assertions, continue-on-error and workflow edits, and runs at Stop; fix PRs prove their regression test fails on base, passes on head and fails on revert (KRN-14; ADAPT arXiv 2611.16114, Trail of Bits regression-hunt); adopt writes .claude/settings.local.json to .gitignore with a CI check that it is not tracked; adopt --verify runs `claude doctor`. Actions lockfile stays a candidate until `gh actions-lock` exists on the host.
Proof: `node --test test/rules/weak-tests.test.ts test/adopt/settings-local-ignore.test.ts` passes.
